previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for severe pain at her G-tube site, which had worsened after running out of oxycodone. She reported prior episodes with similar presentations, and previous imaging showed non-specific inflammation without infection. During this admission, she was restarted on oral oxycodone with good pain control and continued her home tube feeds (NutriHep) without complications. She remained afebrile and hemodynamically stable, with no signs of infection or bleeding. IV Dilaudid was available but not required. She was discharged home with a prescription for oxycodone, instructions to resume feeds at 45 cc/hour, monitor blood glucose, and follow up with her bariatric surgeon and other specialists for ongoing evaluation of chronic pain. Discharge planning included clear instructions on when to seek medical help and avoidance of driving while on pain medication.
